description: The importance of avalanches and avalanche tracks from an ecological point of view is a dataset listed in opendataportal.at, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by raumberg-gumpenstein.at. Monitor/08 Protection against environmental disasters is becoming an ever-increasing challenge for society due to the increased frequency of events. For risk management, which is currently the main focus, and early warning systems, monitoring tools and simulation procedures are necessary. Various monitoring systems are shown in this publication. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-portal-austria.
